title: Many Cultures in One City
text:
My city has people from many countries. Some families came from other places to work or study. At school, children learn about different holidays and foods. My best friend is from Japan, and she teaches me new words.

Every month, the city holds a food festival. People bring dishes from their home countries. Many visitors try new foods and talk to people they do not know. Everyone says the festival helps people understand each other better.

questions.text: Where does the writer's best friend come from?
How often does the city hold a food festival?
Why do children learn about different holidays and foods at school?
options: To help them understand people from other cultures
To prepare them for cooking jobs
Because the school asks them to travel
Because all the holidays happen on the same day

questions.text: What is the writer's main feeling about living in a city with many cultures?

vocabulary.definition: large areas of land with their own government and people
a special event with music, food, or activities for many people
particular kinds of food prepared for eating
people who come to a place for a short time

paragraph_translations: Şehrim birçok ülkeden insanlara ev sahipliği yapıyor. Bazı aileler çalışmak veya okumak için başka yerlerden geldi. Okulda çocuklar farklı bayramları ve yemekleri öğreniyor. En iyi arkadaşım Japonya'dan ve bana yeni kelimeler öğretiyor.

Şehir her ay bir yemek festivali düzenliyor. İnsanlar kendi ülkelerinden yemekler getiriyor. Birçok ziyaretçi yeni yemekleri deniyor ve tanımadıkları insanlarla konuşuyor. Herkes festivalin insanların birbirini daha iyi anlamasına yardımcı olduğunu söylüyor.
